-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func ok[F any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[F]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func bad[F any]() int {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return 1
	}
	comptime.Error("nope")
	return 0
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ok[Pair]())
	fmt.Println(bad[int]())
}
